title: THE SCARY REASON THE SCOOTER WAR ENDED! 🛴
topic: The final resolution of the neighborhood scooter conflict.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: GET AWAY FROM MY STUFF NIX, I ALREADY TOLD YOU [beat] THIS NEIGHBORHOOD IS OFF LIMITS FOR YOUR CRAPPY LITTLE SCOOTER SQUAD!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You think I am here to fight you Bruno, but you have got it all wrong [beat] because I just saw the eviction notice taped to your front door.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: How did you even see that, you little creep, [beat] and why do you even care if my family is getting kicked out of this dump anyway?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Because I am not a monster, and despite all the tires you slashed this month [beat] I am handing you the keys to my limited edition Midnight Scooter.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Nix, are you actually insane right now, that scooter is worth two thousand dollars [beat] and you are just giving it to the guy who ruined our summer?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I am not giving it to him just to be nice, I am giving it to him [beat] so he can sell it and pay his dad’s overdue rent before tonight.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I do not get it, I spent months making your life a living hell [beat] and now you are literally saving my family from sleeping on the street.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It is called a clean slate, Bruno, [beat] but if I ever see you bullying anyone again, I am coming for that scooter back with interest.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nix, I can not believe you actually did it, [beat] the whole neighborhood is finally quiet for the first time since the scooter war began!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: My son might be broke now, but he is the only person in this city [beat] who turned a blood-feud into a peace treaty with the biggest bully.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Most people use weapons to win a war, [beat] but Nix realized that sometimes, the most tactical move you can make is showing a little mercy.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Thanks Nix, I guess the war is officially over [beat] and I think I have finally learned what it actually means to be a real leader.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: And that is how Nix proved [beat] that in this world, kindness is the only currency that actually buys you a completely clean slate.
